title: FREE OPTION TRADING™
about: Disclaimer: This telegram group is created for educational purposes only. I am not a SEBI registered analyst.

analysis_results.recommended_action: Telegram abuse report + takedown of channel and admin handle
analysis_results.case_summary: The operator of the 'FREE OPTION TRADING™' Telegram channel is illegally providing paid investment advice while stating they are not SEBI registered.
analysis_results.analysis: The Telegram channel 'FREE OPTION TRADING™' actively promotes and sells paid investment advisory services for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY and stock options. The operator explicitly states in the group's 'about' section that they are not a SEBI registered analyst.

legal_codes.description: The operator is acting as an investment adviser by offering paid trading calls without SEBI registration.
The operator is dishonestly inducing people to pay for unregistered investment advice.

operator_involvement.how: The operator directly runs the broadcast channel and directs users to a payment link and a contact handle.
